Fictional illustrative art, not a real merchant photo or testimonial.

Specific scene: Exploded photographic arrangement of a gift hamper above a warm ivory tabletop: cookies in a kraft box, ribbon, card, tissue, protective filling, all separate and equally visible around the open box.
